import json
import subprocess
from tools.boat_analysis.model.runtime import ROOT,analysis_values,load_model,numerical_value
from tools.boat_analysis.evidence.records import digest,source_hashes

baseline_path=ROOT/'.tools/oosem-refactor/baseline-numerics.json'
baseline=json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
inputs=analysis_values('BlueDogIntegratedCandidate::Inputs')
old=baseline['analyses']['BlueDogIntegratedCandidate::Inputs']
unchanged={key:{'before':value,'after':inputs[key],'exactlyEqual':value==inputs[key]}
           for key,value in old.items() if key not in {'designNames','designValues'}}
design=dict(zip(inputs['designNames'],inputs['designValues'],strict=True))
analyses={name:{'before':before,'after':analysis_values(name)} for name,before in baseline['analyses'].items()
          if name!='BlueDogIntegratedCandidate::Inputs'}
for values in analyses.values():
    values['exactlyEqual']=values['before']==values['after']
remaining=numerical_value(load_model().calc('BlueDogIntegratedCandidate::RecoveryBankAfterExposure',arguments=[baseline['exposureHours']]).value)
report=dict(baselineFile='baseline-numerics.json',baselineSha256=digest(baseline_path),
            baselineSourceRevision='b12b079855002466a8a95b54a5dba88e8ffc0611',
            sourceRevision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
            modelHash=load_model().hash,sourceHashes=source_hashes([]),
            namedDesign={'before':baseline['composedDesign'],'after':design,'exactlyEqual':baseline['composedDesign']==design},
            unchangedIntegrationInputs=unchanged,unchangedAnalyses=analyses,
            recoveryBank={'exposureHours':baseline['exposureHours'],'beforeWh':baseline['recoveryBankAfterExposureWh'],
                          'afterWh':remaining,'exactlyEqual':remaining==baseline['recoveryBankAfterExposureWh']},
            changedInterfaces={'designBinding':'Complete29-property named configuration replaces9 archive overlays',
                'oldDesignProperties':len(old['designNames']),'newDesignProperties':len(inputs['designNames']),
                'addedOutputs':{key:value for key,value in inputs.items() if key not in old},
                'recoveryAnalysis':'New IC01-only native arithmetic includes explicit configuration applicability; no archived result replaced'},
            interpretation='Exact numerical software regression comparison; no full optimizer rerun or new physical qualification evidence.',
            physicalQualification=False)
report['preserved']=report['namedDesign']['exactlyEqual'] and report['recoveryBank']['exactlyEqual'] and all(x['exactlyEqual'] for x in unchanged.values()) and all(x['exactlyEqual'] for x in analyses.values())
path=ROOT/'build/analysis/oosem-numerical-comparison.json'
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'output':str(path),'preserved':report['preserved'],'recoveryBank':report['recoveryBank'],'changedInterfaces':report['changedInterfaces']},indent=2))
assert report['preserved']
